title: The Kanmon Strait of Friendship and Murderous Intent
notes: Detective-cast (Kogoro, Ran, Conan) omitted by convention. case_type: murder. The old cases/ file's culprit call (s4/Akitaya) was actually correct and its two-strike structure (e2 non-fatal, e3 fatal) held up against the transcript, but it was thin: it missed the Hondou backstory entirely (the 13-years-prior arm-breaking and suicide that supplies everyone's motive), collapsed Ootsubo and Akane into passive 'knows' edges when they are active accessories who built a disguise/impersonation alibi scheme (Ootsubo wore Hario's clothes in the tunnel and used Hario's stolen phone to fake a post-11:00 'ghost' call; Akitaya wore Ootsubo's clothes at the ferry pier to be misidentified by the poor-sighted Eiko), and gave every suspect an identical generic 'was_at' with no location detail even though the transcript specifies distinct alibi locations for each. Eiko's role was also flattened: she did strike Hario first (genuinely believing she'd killed him) and later falsely confessed to shield her friends, but her blow was not the cause of death -- Akitaya's second blow, delivered after Hario regained consciousness, was. This is preserved here as separate assaults/kills edges rather than one merged 'kills' from Eiko. No order/temporal_frame/years_before_present fields per current build guidance.

clues.desc: Dirt/grass under Hario's fingernails and scratch marks on his palm contradict Eiko's account that he 'fell and stopped moving' -- proves he revived and struggled to rise after her blow, before a second, fatal blow was struck.

Eiko wears glasses only while driving, but the aquarium employee confirms she had none on when she claimed to recognize Ootsubo waving from the distant ferry pier -- she could not actually have identified him at that range.

The tunnel's surveillance camera is ceiling-mounted and only films from above, so the running man's face was never visible -- matching clothing alone cannot confirm the man seen at 11:00 AM was really Hario.

strikes Hario with the rock after he refuses to apologize to Hondou's memory; believes she has killed him and flees

edges.method: second blow to the head with the same rock, after Hario had regained consciousness and tried to rise

edges.detail: calls Eiko to meet at the aquarium, then points out the disguised Akitaya at the pier as if he were Ootsubo, exploiting her poor vision
